notes.title: The Cooking Class - First Course
notes.content:
Here at Another Dev Company we want to tell you a tale.
The Cooking Class is nothing but the tip of the iceberg of the story we wrote.
Many of you have already unlocked some secrets, and we cherish you. As you know, we are here, we are present.

With "The Cooking Class - First Course", we want to have a deep dive into the lore by showing you other sides of the Dupont family and associates.

We have decided to launch this episode as a "Free for all" standalone because we care about you enjoying the plot, the connections between the characters, the deeper meaning behind every bite, pun intended.

New features, fresh look at the plot, the complete soundtrack of "The Handsome Mesh - Debugging Log" and much more to come, soon on Steam.
Stay tuned and spread the word.

notes.title: An Honest Statement
notes.content:
When we first launched The Cooking Class we aimed to provide
the players with a fresh touch on the horror genre. We failed.

It was our first PC featured game and inexperience and enthusiasm played a major role in what, in our eyes, made the game underwhelming for performances and storyline alike.
For that, we take all the accountability there is to be taken.
Although difficult, sometimes overwhelming, we decided that
you, the players, matter the most, and our efforts and blood sweat 
and tears one day will be paid back with your love for the game.
So, we basically re-did the whole game to the maximum of our possibilities, skills and budget, which is very close to none.

Some mechanics will stay the same, but we added depth to the storyline which was vague and
tasteless, we have changed graphical and technical aspects of the gameplay, we have started a featured YouTube channel to enhance the story-driven experience, through a spin-off analog horror web series, named "Thom Dupont Exposed",[previewyoutube=cDapkUHyuzQ;full][/previewyoutube] that will shed lights and cast shadows on the history of the Dupont family and their acquaintances, associates, victims.

We also have jam packed the game with hints, easter eggs, interactive features we won't spoil here and a cypher for you to decipher.
This re-release means a lot to us. It means sleepless nights, self doubt, excitement, passion, moments of pure joy and utter discomfort.
We could have pocketed the money and start working on a new game.
Yes, we could have done that. But we didn't because we REALLY care about YOU enjoying our game.
This doesn't mean that the game is perfect and flawless. As every indie game, or product in general, will have weaknesses and strengths, flaws and good parts, but we will always listen to your criticism, as we did before, we always will.

The Duponts are now our extended virtual family, we had lunch with them (gross right?), we talked to them, we've got to know them better, and now they are inviting you again to cook with them. With us.
Your support will have two effects:
the storyline we wrote will go on developing and the plot will unfold deeper than you could ever expect, a true rabbit hole, a maze of characters, hints, nods, branches, different directions and mysteries.
Secondly, it will make two small time developers happy and content that someone, somewhere, is playing their game, is loving the story, is entering the family.

This is as honest as we could get.
No filters, no lies, just accountability and passion. We are no big time development studio, but we aim to be amongst the fan favorites.

Thank you for reading this far.

We really hope you'll love the update. It should be released very soon.

notes.title: Let's Cook Some More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43319889/91297874453bff565f07c919f4518cb7cb2ff743.png[/img]First and foremost, thank you for your support. Your criticism, both positive and negative has given us the drive to push through hardships and we are currently updating the game to make it more enjoyable, even for players who have played and finished the story, yes, there will be surprises for you too!
We hope you're hungry. Because we're Cooking for you.
"The Cooking Class" is the first chapter of a family story, we're currently developing the prequel chapter which will shed light upon the origin of the Dupont Family, and while doing that, we're also taking our time to better the first Chapter.
We really believe you will enjoy exploring deep into the lore of the next chapters. The interlude of the prequel will be released as soon as possible as a free test of the game. Just like a demo, but not quite. Is gonna be pivotal a part of the story.
We want you to know that we have read and answered every comment, we listened to your suggestions, because what's cooking if the person eating doesn't like it? A recipe has gotta be perfected. Little by little.
Here's a list of what you will find in the next update, which should be available in the next month or so.

- More lore and files
- Different lighting and Post Processing
- An alternative finale
- Field of focus implementation
- A very well hidden easter egg (not for eating purposes)

Thanks for your love, patience, and support.
The Devs Team
